display_name: LoRa W24 跨 chirp 观测参考与离散度
description: 双阶段 W24 DURA 匹配比较单 chirp 局部参考与排除当前 chirp 后的包内参考。
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Original 7615e8e4 archived training release for fitting; archived W24 inference release for prediction.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full and native_residual_w24_v1 practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: TX-blind source U IQ and paired generic perturbations only until freeze. Source V and, if qualified, Full-only target; no Residual execution.

checkpoint.initialization: Scratch; identical expanded W24 two-prior state with nine observation conditioning fields.

sources.role: Archived code and frozen external comparator only

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Native W24 matched source fit proof, exact reader F/complete.json binding, fixed blind control archive
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No weights inherited during fitting. Runtime source metadata and frozen state require original contract. No target or TX ancestry in fit.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze after step 3600. On the fixed 300-packet Full source V, peer half must exceed direct, local half and original 40k half in six-scene count, meet or exceed all three in low urban, and meet direct on clean. Only then run three Full formal shards and independent score.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 physical GPU pool 3, 7, 6, 5 in configured preference order; max one worker per card and two total, 12 GiB free.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent phases on wrong role, invalid gradients/numerics, source baseline mismatch, missing artifacts or formal prediction mismatch. Preserve artifacts and other jobs.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source scorer; E:/type10-7/local_envs/phase1-cu128/Scripts/python.exe -m experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_third_prior collect-score --peer after the three formal Full shards freeze.

notes: Both arms add three receive-only features to the same archived DURA stages: normalized complex innovation and dispersion.

The local arm estimates reference and dispersion over nine samples of the current chirp. The peer arm uses the other seven chirps at the same sample in the existing dechirped coordinates, then smooths their dispersion over nine points.
No direct waveform averaging is used in the output. Both arms use two priors, four CG and a fixed half center edit; the frozen Full source panel also compares full edits.
Full formal goals: six at least 162000/180000, low urban at least 25500/30000, clean at least 28566/30000.
